description: This file contains the implementation of the Smarty internal plugin class responsible for compiling PHP expressions within templates. It defines the class Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_Php, including methods for compiling code, parsing PHP tags, and handling various PHP code scenarios during template compilation.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_Php
classes.description: A class dedicated to compiling PHP expressions within Smarty templates, handling various PHP code types, and parsing PHP tags.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles code for generating output from any expression, handling different PHP types, and processing code based on the compiler's PHP handling mode.

methods.name: parsePhp
methods.description: Lexically processes PHP tags, detects PHP code boundaries, and prepares PHP code blocks for compilation, handling comments and special cases.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: A callback for escaping PHP code in PHP_QUOTE mode, converting special characters to HTML entities.
